headline: Junior Frontend Developer
summary: Detail-oriented Frontend Developer and recent Computing graduate from Islington College with a strong passion for building responsive and user-friendly web interfaces. Proficient in React.js and modern CSS frameworks, with a proven ability to translate complex designs into functional code through various academic and personal projects.

experiences.title: Frontend Development Intern
description: Assisted in the development of a client-facing dashboard using React.js and Tailwind CSS, improving UI consistency across 15+ modules.
Collaborated with UI/UX designers to convert high-fidelity Figma mockups into pixel-perfect, responsive web components.
Participated in daily stand-ups and code reviews, gaining exposure to professional Agile development workflows and Git version control.
Optimized front-end assets and implemented lazy loading, which improved the initial page load time by 20%.

experiences.title: Lead Frontend Developer
description: Developed a comprehensive e-commerce frontend template specifically tailored for the Nepali market using React.js and Redux Toolkit.
Integrated Khalti Payment Gateway sandbox for simulated transaction flows.
Implemented advanced search and filtering functionality to handle dynamic product catalogs.
Ensured 100% responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and desktop views using CSS Grid and Flexbox.

experiences.title: Frontend Developer
description: Collaborated with a team of three at Islington College to build a centralized resource portal for BSc Computing students.
Managed state using Context API and handled asynchronous data fetching from a Node.js backend.
Successfully deployed the application on Vercel, achieving a 95+ score on Lighthouse for accessibility and SEO.
